READ: findings.json
I revised plan.md on disk (version 1.1, findings-input: true) to address all 6 findings. Step ids P1–P22 are unchanged.
- P1 (blocker): D3 is rewritten so that v1 modules are guarded as undeclared publishers. P2 adds InputOwnership.constrains_any(). Whenever the ownership table constrains any pair, P4 hands the v1 route an _OwnedBus facade, so tests/test_loader.py:1345 stays green without any change. P4 also gains AC44 tests for a v1 publisher.
- P2: In P5, a module that owns '*' now binds only the wildcard destination, with exclusions, and never its own concrete rows. P5 also gains an AC14 test in the exact shipped shape and a pairwise non-overlap test.
- P3 (blocker): P14's tests now cover only what P14 builds. The users.read part of AC3 moves to P18, and the in-flight part of AC28 moves to P15.
- P4: P6 now depends on [P5].
- P5: The AC37 docs guard moves to tests/test_phase5_docs_status.py, so the trial file still collects exactly 8 tests. P20, P21, P22 and the ordering section are updated to match.
- P6: D8 and P15 now define an explicit transmission boundary. The call is marked not-emitted first, and marking it emitted and handing the frame to the transport happen with no await in between. A send onto a closed connection is refused provider_not_ready. P15 adds tests that interrupt the call before the send (cancel, deadline, connection closed) plus an AST check. Whether the installed aiohttp writes without an await first can only be confirmed at build time.
